title: Shinra's Basic Training
description: This is a simulated battle against infantrymen. The difficulty is set low, so it should pose no problems for a SOLDIER operative. Relax and enjoy the training.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Basic warm-up; Barrier + Battle Stance easily handles groups.

title: Shinra's Advanced Training
description: This is a simulated battle against Shinra's new gun bull heads. You may have fought them before, but that doesn't necessarily mean you'll win again. Overconfidence may kill you...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

title: 50 Shinra Troopers
description: You will be sparring with our infantrymen., Though each individual poses little challenge, the fact that they will appear in a constant stream should even the odds., Let us see how you fare.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: 100 Shinra Troopers
description: It's another practice session, but with powered-up infantrymen—and more of them!, This should be pretty tough even for a SOLDIER operative. Give it all you've got.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: 200 Shinra Troopers
description: The enemy troopers are even tougher this time., Can you survive while defeating a seemingly never-ending stream of them?, We look forward to watching you in action.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: 1,000 Shinra Troopers
description: Zack, we now understand how strong you are, so here is our last training session with the most powerful infantrymen we have. They will seem truly endless, coming at you again and again and again... Are you ready for the ultimate sparring challenge?

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

title: Challenge from Security
description: Members of the Security Department have requested a joint training session with SOLDIER., Some of them seem to regard SOLDIER with a passionate sense of rivalry., It's only a training session, but don't take it lightly.
unlockCondition: Speak with Shinra Captain on Loveless Street in Sector 8.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Second Challenge
description: Members of the Security Department have requested another joint training session with SOLDIER., They have robots to support them this time., Proceed with caution.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Third Challenge
description: Members of the Security Department have requested yet another joint training session with SOLDIER., A statement from them reads: "We were holding back in the previous sessions.", They are desperate and may do anything to save face. Be careful.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Getting Serious
description: The persistent members of the Security Department have sent SOLDIER another challenge to a joint training session., Making excuses, they claim the difference in budget between the departments to be the reasons for their losses., Go show them exactly why we are combat experts.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Armed Challenge
description: Members of the Security Department have sent SOLDIER yet another challenge to a joint training session., It seems they have succeeded in securing funds and have new weapons at their disposal., We in SOLDIER never blame a loss on the budget., Win the session and teach them the meaning of dignity.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Last Challenge
description: Members of the Security Departments, on a losing streak, have yet again challenged SOLDIER to a joint training session., They have used up their entire budget on this one., We know we've had too many of these, but this on is sure to be the last., Savor it for what it is.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Next-Generation Weapons
description: After vanishing from Wutai, Genesis has formed his own army and commenced an attack on Shinra troops., Shinra is developing new weapons to counter the emerging threat., We want you to participate in testing these weapons.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: New Mechanical Weapons
description: The Shinra weapons that vanished with Genesis reappeared in his forces' hands., To counter them, we have started developing new and improved weapons., We ask for your support in testing this enhanced gear.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: To Quash Genesis's Forces
description: The New Weapons Group, dedicating to developing more powerful weapons, has obtained extensive operation data on the weapons used by Genesis' forces., They have succeeded in developing new weapons that should overcome their current arsenal., We want you to participate in testing these weapons.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Experiments Gone Wrong
description: Hastily developed weapons designed to fight Genesis have gone berserk., The testing site is closed off, so there is no concern of damage spreading outside, but we must bring the situation under control., Destroy all machines inside the testing area.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Robots in the City
description: New weapons have been developed to counter the elusive Genesis copies in the city., Your cooperation is needed in the testing area for us to obtain combat data for defending Midgar.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: A Director's Request
description: We have been asked by Director Scarlet at the Arms Development Department to test new weapons., This is a very new version of an unmanned weapon currently in use, and we must collect as much combat data as much as possible., Destroy all machines within the battle area.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Urban Combat Operations
description: We have newly formed urban combat force., Final adjustments must be made based on combat testing before they are sent out on real missions., We ask for your participation in the city-themed training event.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Cyber-Sabotage
description: One of Genesis' secret agents has introduced a virus to a fleet of our prototype weapons. The weapons are now out of control and attacking our own people., Track down the large four weapons and destroy them!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Stolen Shinra Weapons
description: While Shinra troops were gearing up for battle with Genesis,, AVALANCHE, the anti-Shinra group caught them off guard and stole their weapons for use in their own offensive., Go to AVALANCHE's base to fight them and reclaim our weapons.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Destroy the Mobile Artillery
description: Mobile artillery produced to counter Genesis' weapons has gone berserk due to careless QA testing., They have broken through the factory walls and are now heading toward the residential district., Destroy them before they reach the citizenry.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Testing New Weapons
description: We're going to conduct a test on new weapons designed to combat Genesis troops and Wutai remnants hiding in the caves., Enter the test dungeon and fight against every weapon you encounter.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Weapons Comparison Test
description: We want you to participate in an evaluation of next-generation Sweeper models., Four new Sweepers have been placed in the testing area; fight them one at a time., The test is over when you have destroyed all four.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Special Ops Weapons
description: The Special Operation Weapons Group uses Shinra's most cutting-edge technologies to create the best possible machine without concern for mass production., We would like for you to help us test these machines.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Special Ops Weapons Return
description: They may look the same on the outside, but their internals have been extensively reworked., The subjects are already in the testing area, so if you would kindly participate in our evaluation...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Tarantula Test
description: We have completed work on Tarantula, the latest machine designed to support us in our plight against Genesis copies., It's time to test its performance by pitting it against you., Please head over to the testing area.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Shinra Machines Unit
description: A new combat team has been formed, capable of fighting more efficiently., We want to test their abilities against SOLDIER before we send them off to real combat., Gear up for a fight in the test arena.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Better Death Machines
description: Plans to create powered-up Death Machines are underway., As an intermediary step, we have released a new model... but its true worth is unknown until its testing phase, so we ask you to participate., Please enter the testing arena.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Final Versions of the Spider
description: The Spider robots have been overhauled and redesigned to be rolled out as the Guardian Eyes., There are presently four of them in the testing arena., Please enter and fight them whenever you are ready.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Beginnings
description: Monsters are teeming in the outskirts of Midgar., Experts on study of planet life say the monsters pose a potential threat to Shinra., We are unsure of the validity of these claims, but an investigation is in order.
unlockCondition: Progress to Chapter 4; Talk to the man at the top of the SE stairs in Sector 8.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

title: Approaching the Outskirts
description: The outbreak of monsters near Midgar has resulted in a Sector 8 woman filing for damages., We cannot afford to let litigation spread any further., Hurry to the area and eliminate all monsters in sight.
unlockCondition: Progress to Chapter 4; Talk to the woman on the street on Loveless Avenue in Sector 8.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

title: Sightings in Sector 5
description: We still do not know the cause for the massive number of monsters,, but a Sector 5 resident reports seeing them in the scrapyard in the slums., Hurry there and eradicate the monsters.
unlockCondition: Progress to Chapter 5; Talk to the girl near the train entrance in Slum Market

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Defend the Slums
description: Residents of the slums have decided to take matters into their own hands to fight the monsters., Hurry there and eliminate the monsters before any of the slum residents are hurt.
unlockCondition: Progress to Chapter 5; Talk to the girl near the park entrance in Slum Street.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Highway Closed
description: Monsters are prowling the road that connects Midgar and Kalm., This has left members of a mako reactor inspection team from Kalm stranded in Midgar., You must eliminate the threat and make the road safe for travel.
unlockCondition: Progress to Chapter 6; Talk to Shinra Soldier on the 2nd floor of the Entrance area of the Shinra Building

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Truth in the Wasteland
description: It has been determined that the monsters in Midgar are escaped examples from Hojo Laboratories., We must keep this information confidential., Go to the target zone and eliminate all monsters.
unlockCondition: Progress to Chapter 6; Talk to the Researcher near the world map in the Exhibit room of the Shinra Building; Must complete missions 2-1-1 through 2-1-5 to make him appear.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Slums of Midgar
description: This is a battle with monsters who claim the the slums in lower Midgar as their turf., There actually is little strength with them; perhaps you can use them to work out your tactics for fighting against monsters.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

title: Modeoheim
description: This is a battle against monsters indigenous to Modeo region., The cold weather is not conducive to a wider variety of monsters, but they should have enough bite to make your sparring worthwhile.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Nibelheim
description: This is a battle against monsters indigenous to Nibelheim region., Although Nibelheim offers a wide variety of monsters, this mission will primarily features Bomb monsters.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

title: Nibelheim II
description: This is a battle against monsters indigenous to Nibelheim region., Although Nibelheim is known for a wide variety of monsters, this mission will primarily feature cave-dwelling creatures.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Gongaga
description: This is a battle against monsters indigenous to Gongaga region., The remoteness of the region may be contributing factor to the variety of monsters., Some are very dangerous. You have been warned.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: World of Monsters
description: These battles will be against monsters that have been cataloged by Shinra Company., You may not have encountered some of them before., Use caution when fighting them.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Unidentified Monsters
description: We have confirmed reports of an attack by a monster resembling an Epiornis., Go to where it was last sighted and purge the area of all monsters.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Pair Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga/Firaga to neutralize instant-death mobs.

title: Mass Elimination
description: We have information that a group of Titanis, the newly discovered Epiornis-type, is on the move., Hurry to their location and eliminate all monsters in the area.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Pair Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga/Firaga to neutralize instant-death mobs.

title: Aerial Monsters
description: We are receiving multiple reports of attacks by flying monsters., Even worse, a battalion in the area has been wiped out by the monsters., Go investigate forthwith and look into what exactly might have occurred.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Pair Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga/Firaga to neutralize instant-death mobs.

title: Subspecific Movers
description: Reports have some in of monsters similar to the Movers discovered in the previous missions., Eliminate these dangerous entities.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Pair Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga/Firaga to neutralize instant-death mobs.

title: The Sealed Cavern
description: A Shinra unit exploring the caves has reported a monster encounter., We have instructed the unit to evacuate the caves for now, but we cannot leave the area as is., You mission is to eliminate the threats and secure the zone.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Pair Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga/Firaga to neutralize instant-death mobs.

title: Operation: Desert Island
description: An employee has informed us about a monster encounter on a desert island., There seems to be no evidence of these creatures making forays to the outside world,, but they should be eliminated for our security nonetheless.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: A Solitary Island
description: Many parts of the world still serve as sanctuaries for monsters, and we wish to identify as many of these as possible., Shinra troops have entered one such area and were wiped out., Get to the island and uncover whatever mysteries lies beyond its shores.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Wasteland Investigation
description: We received reports that one of Shinra's robot scouts was destroyed by an unidentified flying object., The incident took place in a region that has yet to be explored., This is a suitable job for SOLDIER. Go to the site now.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: An Unknown Island
description: An entire Shinra investigation team was wiped out by monsters in unexplored territory., The team was unable to send status reports; we assume the monsters are brutal and bloodthirsty., Please go investigate the site.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Excavation Site Survey
description: A giant monster lived in a closed mako excavation facility. Go to the site and investigate., If the monster is dangerous, it must be eliminated.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Cave-In Investigation
description: There was an inexplicable cave-in deep inside the caves., Chances are monsters to blame, but we need you to investigate the area and look into the cause of the accident., If monsters were indeed the cause, you know what to do.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Whatever Stands in Your Way
description: The Volcano bomb monster you found in the previous mission has been sighted in another cave., A team was sent to investigate, but their progress was halted by totally different monsters., Hurry over to the site.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

subGroup: M2-5: In Search of the Unknown
title: Investigation of the Caverns
description: While pursuing the monsters you had reported on in your last mission, we uncovered a new species of creature., We would like you to conduct an investigation on these mysterious, cave-dwelling monsters.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

subGroup: M2-5: In Search of the Unknown
title: New Species Found
description: We have received word from our troops of a new type of Mover., As you know, Mover possess extremely powerful magic. We need SOLDIER to fight this threat in place of the troops., Get moving and face off against the Movers.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

subGroup: M2-5: In Search of the Unknown
title: More New Species Found
description: We have received reports of a new breed of monster in the caves,, but obstructing the way forward are the Mover EXs we discovered in the previous mission., Go to the cave and eliminate them.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

subGroup: M2-5: In Search of the Unknown
title: New Cavern Found
description: An undiscovered cavern has been unearthed., At this time, we do not even know what kind of life forms might be found there., We therefore must ask a SOLDIER operative to conduct an investigation by exploring within and collecting information.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

subGroup: M2-5: In Search of the Unknown
title: Another Cavern
description: We unearthed another cave near the one you explored in the previous mission., We assume some presence of monsters, so head over to the site and gather all the information you can.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

subGroup: M2-5: In Search of the Unknown
title: The Great Beast
description: In this area, the natives refer to a creature as the "Great Beast"., All we know that it is indeed extremely large; all other facts are cloaked in mystery., Go to its supposed location and find the truth about this creature.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

subGroup: M3-1: Genesis's Forces on the March
title: Foes on the Waterfront
description: The Coast Guard has spotted Genesis troops, so they're likely to have an outpost near the coast., Head there and vanquish the enemy!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Basic warm-up; Barrier + Battle Stance easily handles groups.

subGroup: M3-1: Genesis's Forces on the March
title: Massive Machines
description: We have received reports of Genesis troops hiding large-scale weapons in the caves., Destroy them and stop their advance!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

subGroup: M3-1: Genesis's Forces on the March
title: Eliminate the Copies
description: Genesis troops have been ID'd by scouts on their way to wasteland., Vanquish this core group and stop the enemy from moving in!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

subGroup: M3-1: Genesis's Forces on the March
title: Destroy the Death Machines
description: We have found a supply depot for Genesis troops!, We can slow their momentum by crushing this base., Destroy the three types of Death Machines in their main arsenal and shut down the base!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

subGroup: M3-1: Genesis's Forces on the March
title: Eliminate the Death Machines
description: Genesis' forces are reorganizing., There seems to be no change in their weaponry, but the troops organized around the Death Machines are not to be trifled with., Attack them before they start mobilizing!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

subGroup: M3-1: Genesis's Forces on the March
title: Midgar Defense Operations
description: Genesis troops have been sighted in Midgar., The citizenry has been evacuated and the area blocked off., Eradicate the forces before they are able to infiltrate other areas.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Foes in the Slums
description: A group of Genesis copies that previously attacked Shinra Building has escaped into the slums, promising to have their revenge., Head for the slums and make sure that that never happens.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Take Back the Carrier
description: Genesis copies captured for research were being shipped to Midgar by a carrier, but the ship were overrun by the copies., You must get on the carrier, eradicate the Genesis copies, and take back the ship.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Raid the Enemy's Stronghold
description: We have uncovered the location to which Genesis copies were escaping via cargo ship., There is no doubt that they have a stronghold there., Deploy immediately and attack the base!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

title: Enemy Attack Prevention
description: We have received words of Genesis troops in the underground caves plotting an attack on Shinra facilities., Destroy the Guard Scorpion and put an end to their plans.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Pursue the Foes
description: Genesis copies were sighted in the rocky stretch by the ocean., The area is unpopulated, but we cannot let Genesis troops build another base., Eliminate them!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

title: Foes in the Wasteland
description: The unstoppable momentum of Genesis troops has now reached the wasteland just outside Midgar., Defeat the commander and stop them from advancing any further!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

title: Red Alert!
description: This is an emergency situation! Genesis troops have raided the basement level of the Shinra Building., Operations are continuing as normal to avoid panic. The enemy must be kept from entering the upper floor., Head there discreetly and eliminate them forthwith.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

title: Base in the Caverns
description: Genesis troops cannot be stopped., They have setup a base in a cave near Midgar and are preparing for their next attack., Infiltrate the caves and destroy their weapons to quash their plans.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Pair Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga/Firaga to neutralize instant-death mobs.

title: Surprise Attack on Midgar
description: A battalion of Genesis copies has commenced a surprise attack on Midgar., The base we previously destroy appears to have been a decoy., Hurry to the site and smash the Genesis copies.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Unlock Costly Punch + Brutal (M7-4-6) and deplete boss Skill Power gauges.

title: One Base at a Time
description: New sightings of Genesis troops are filtering in., We have no choice but to crush their base, one by one, to stop their invasion., Head for the caves where they were last seen, and vanquish the enemy.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Unlock Costly Punch + Brutal (M7-4-6) and deplete boss Skill Power gauges.

title: Rumble in Midgar
description: The supposed plans by Genesis's main forces to attack Midgar were merely a diversion., A special operation unit has already infiltrated Midgar., Eliminate the enemy on sight.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Regain the Mako Facility
description: A mako excavation facility has been taken over by Genesis troops., If they were to obtain mako energy, it would greatly boost their capabilities., The facility must be taken back at all cost. Eliminate the enemy in the facility.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Regain Shinra's Materia
description: Some of the weapons possessed by Genesis troops have apparently been powered up with materia stolen from Shinra., Sneak into enemy's base, destroy their weapons, and get our materia back.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Powered-Up Copies
description: Powered-up copies of Genesis have been confirmed., We had predicted that Genesis' forces would fortify themselves with these copies, and facing defeat at their hands is not an option., Eliminate the battalion.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Reinforced Copies
description: Genesis troops are successfully powering up their copies, and we have found a battalion led by copies of extraordinary magnitude., They may be formidable, but you must fight and eliminate them.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Return to Midgar
description: We have discovered that one of Genesis' special units has quietly snuck into inner Midgar., Conduct a raid on their hideout and vanquish Genesis' forces before they make a move.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Destroy the Copy Factory
description: We have discovered one of Genesis' bases where toughened copies are being produced., We must prevent them from strengthening their forces., Eliminate the enemy inside the base.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Strongest Copies Yet
description: Despite the destruction of one of their factories, Genesis troops have sent new types of Genesis copies to the frontlines., Only SOLDIER can take them out. Destroy the new copies!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Intercept the Copies
description: Mass production has begun on new Genesis copies., A team of these new monstrosities is fast approaching Midgar even as we speak., We can't allow them to get any closer, so go now and eliminate this army of copies!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Attack the Copies' Base
description: There seems to be no end to how far Genesis' forces will go to strengthen their copies., We have new intel on a base inside the caves organizing yet another copy of army., Hurry to the caves and vanquish them!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Genesis's Special Ops Unit
description: A special operations unit with a new Genesis copy as its commander has entered Midgar., They seem to be planning another attack on the Shinra Building, but the Turks have discovered their hideout., Head out to the site immediately and eradicate the enemy!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Chase the Copies
description: With the continuous stream of copies successfully defeated, Genesis troops have been cleaned out of the Midgar area., Let us take advantage of our momentum. Raid the newly found base and smash the remnants!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Defeat the Copies
description: Both SOLDIER and Shinra troops are destroying Genesis' bases one after another., In retaliation, the remnants seem to be planning a focused attack against the Shinra troops., Vanquish the remnants before they gather!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: The Last of the Genesis Troops
description: Genesis troops, which have lost most of their momentum, have been hiding out in their last base, developing the strongest Genesis copies yet., We have discovered the location of this base. Vanquish the copies and eradicate the enemy!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Experiment No. 101
description: Your battle with the summon made for valuable data., I have used this data to create a new battle sim; be my guest and give it a try if you're up to it., But I must warn you; though it is only a simulation, the damage you receive will be very real.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

title: Experiment No. 102
description: Bahamut! A rare find indeed..., I thank you for such an invaluable sample., I have created another battle simulation based on this data, so have at it once you're ready.

title: Experiment No. 103
description: I already know it's a failure, so I'm not especially keen on this... but I did re-create an Angeal copy based on combat intel., It's just a monster with a little bit of intelligence., On second thought, it's probably a perfect match.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

title: Experiment No. 104
description: A very intriguing sample. A Bahamut strain!, Genesis has more than a few tricks up his sleeve. So, this is a simulated battle; with special thanks to Genesis., Allow me to collect more combat data while you dish out the hurt.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Experiment No. 105
description: Is Genesis dead?, Actually, that is of no concern to me—my interest lay only in his abilities., He showed remarkable growth for a failed experiment. Far more promising than you.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Unlock Costly Punch + Brutal (M7-4-6) and deplete boss Skill Power gauges.

title: Experiment No. 106
description: Too bad about Angeal. He could have lived longer had he only returned to Shinra., I would have preferred to get his body back to my lab... but at the very least, I retrieved some data from which I created a simulation of his final state., Perhaps you might be able to tell just how faithful a reproduction it is...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

title: Experiment No. 107
description: Is the hero really dead?, Things would have been more interesting if only I had arrived at Nibelheim a bit sooner..., We'll have to settle a simulation based on the data left in the monitoring system at the mako reactor.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

title: Experiment No. 108
description: I wonder if Sephiroth gave his all fighting you?, It's too bad the monitoring system cannot record the subject's mind as well. Still, the data shows significant strength., Could he have accepted you as a SOLDIER member? An interesting state he was in...

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

title: Experiment No. 109
description: Failures, failures, failures... what annoyances., And yet I suppose even failures have values as experimental objects., This was a man who used to constantly get in my way, but now he will work for me as a test subject.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Pair Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga/Firaga to neutralize instant-death mobs.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Unlock Costly Punch + Brutal (M7-4-6) and deplete boss Skill Power gauges.

title: Experiment No. 114

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) for Break HP Limit and Mog's Amulet for rare drops.

title: Experiment No. 115
description: I have prepared an experiment that baffles its opponent with its behavior., One with the simplest thought process (like you) may just end up losing again and again., That in itself would be a sight to see... but then, which would I call the sample, you or my experiment?

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Unlock Costly Punch + Brutal (M7-4-6) and deplete boss Skill Power gauges.

title: Experiment No. 117

description: Gun Bull Heads have been sent on to fights against both Genesis and Wutai forces, but something has made the machines unable to distinguish between friend and foe., We have no choice but to enter the deployment area and destroy our own machines.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: Continuing into the Caves
description: This is another request for an investigation into the caves., All reports suggest Genesis' forces are still active., You must proceed with the investigation while eliminating the enemy.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Push VIT/SPR to 220+ and HP 50k+ using 98/980% Libra conversion.

title: A New Path Discovered
description: We have reports of a new route found inside the caves., We assume neither Genesis nor Wutai forces are aware of this path as yet., Commence your investigation immediately.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: To the Lower Levels
description: We learned much from the previous mission, including how to descend to lower levels., We have decided for you to continue your investigation., Begin your mission immediately.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Signs of Materia
description: A strong materia reaction has been detected inside the caves; some sort of materia may be buried in the soil., Please head to the site and collect the materia.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: To the End
description: The full scope of the caves still eludes us., The subterranean depths keep growing larger, and we have no choice but to explore them bottom to top., Go to your assigned area and begin the investigation.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Genesis's Challenge
description: Activity by Genesis troops has been confirmed deep in the caves yet again., They seem to be conducting a search inside the caves armed with new weapons., Head to where they were last seen and eliminate them.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Genesis's New Weapon
description: The new weapons in Genesis' arsenal seem to possess overwhelming power., These must be destroyed to halt enemy's offensive. Move to their position with all haste.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Genesis's Super Weapon
description: Genesis troops have readied stronger weapons, and only a SOLDIER 1st Class can survive their attack., Infiltrate the caves and destroy the prototypes before they get the chance to go online.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Wutai's Best
description: Wutai troops thought destroyed have been sighted in the caves., Their best troopers have quietly moved to lower levels of the caves., Their goals are unknown, but we must halt whatever plans they have., Vanquish the Wutai elites.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: No More Wutai
description: The Wutai in the caves have been eliminated., Let us take this opportunity to further explore the deeper levels., Monsters have been confirmed as present, so you must continue fighting as you move downward.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Genesis's Ambition
description: Genesis troops are advancing again., Their new frontline weapons are dealing massive damage, but yielding the caves to them is not an option., Vanquish this worthy enemy now!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Genesis's Passion
description: New Genesis copies, using tactics we've never encountered before, are readying an army and marching into the caves with unstoppable momentum., Pursue them and stop their advance to prevent them from achieving their sinister goals.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: A Fresh Start
description: Genesis troops are no more. Wutai forces have vanished., There is nothing left to do but keep moving deeper into the depths of the caves.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Machines Gone Haywire
description: Shinra's weapons are acting up; something in the caves is making them go berserk., Destroy our machines to keep them from hurting our own people.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Only for SOLDIER
description: Our own machines have gone berserk, and the losses we experienced are unacceptable., We are pulling our troops out of the caves, but SOLDIER must keep moving forward., Take out any monsters in your way!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Only for 1st Class
description: The monsters we've encountered are so ridiculously powerful that SOLDIER operatives are struggling to stay in the fight., 2nd and 3rd Class operatives cannot go any further. We're counting on you.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Hojo's Monsters
description: It seems monsters have been released from Hojo's lab into the caves., They are unlikely to distinguish friend from foe., Though we may be breaching the chain of command, you are permitted to fight back if they attack you.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Further Below
description: We are thoroughly impressed that you have eliminated Hojo's monsters-no offense to him., With your abilities, we are confident that you can handle any foe that comes in your way., Keep up the pace and move forward.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Unusually Strong Monsters
description: If our data is correct, these monsters are unusually strong; the caves must be the cause., We are analyzing the monster data from the areas we have already covered, but it's not enough., Please go deeper and collect more data for us.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Abnormal Power
description: We are fairly certain that the monsters inside the caves are being strengthened by an unknown energy., The energy seems to grow as we advance further down., Descend to the next level and help us find the cause.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: A Lonely Journey
description: You are the only one left exploring these caves; any other SOLDIER 1st Class operatives have long since retired., The monsters are becoming increasingly vicious. Proceed with caution.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Even Deeper
description: We have confirmed the existence of Guard Hounds from the area you covered in the last mission., They may have gone berserk by themselves, but it is more likely that there was an external stimulus., Please gather more information as we continue to analyze our data.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Toughest Monsters
description: An analysis of the data tells us that the monsters in these caves are exponentially stronger than they are above the ground., Even those that are relatively docile above ground become belligerent in these caves., We trust you, but do not let your guard down.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: The Lowest Tier
description: You have almost reached the lowest level of the caves., We will give you all the support we can., You may look forward to this mission's compensation. Good luck.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Weapons Gone Haywire
description: It is now clear that the mysterious energy can influence not only monsters, but machines as well., The mechanical weapons go on unprogrammed rampages powered by a seemingly endless supply of energy., You're the only one who can solve this mystery.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Biomechanical Threats
description: Though mechanical, the Master Blades you encountered in your last mission had taken on biological behavior from the unknown energy., The energy seems to have properties beyond our imagination. It's almost within your reach!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Life Form of Energy
description: Analysis of the mysterious energy has led us to believe that not only does it make machines behave like living organism, but any other life form killed by it could take on an entirely different behavior., Evidence suggest that a few of our men have disappeared in the lower levels., Don't let anything take you by surprise! Keep your courage up and move forward!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: The Reigning Deity
description: After the mysterious energy's influence, we are sure that its source is just beyond here., There's no telling what you may find, but we've come too far to turn back now., We look forward to reading your report, Zack!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Superboss Minerva (20,000,000 HP on Hard Mode): 255 VIT/SPR, 99,999 HP, Wall, Costly Punch, Aerial Drain, Mug (steal 99 Phoenix Downs), Genji set.

title: Where's the Cactuar?
description: One of our executives has lost his pet Cactuar., It seems the prickly pet has disappeared with classified company information in its hands. This security breach must be dealt with at once., A door-to-door investigation by Shinra has revealed the Cactuar to be in the wasteland. Exterminate it on sight.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Kactuar?
description: The Cactuar found in the last mission was only a look-alike., Another thorough investigation by Shinra has revealed the Cactuar to be in the wasteland., This one has got to be our executive's Cactuar! Exterminate it immediately!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Cactuar Found?
description: If we leave things as is, it is only a matter of time before sensitive information is leaked and heads roll., We must, for the sake of these heads, find the Cactuar at all cost., Further investigation has determined its location to be in the wasteland. There is no time to lose!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

title: Find the Tonberry!
description: Our president's personal chef has requested that we reclaim his prized knife of legend., Investigation has revealed that a Tonberry in the coal mines is currently in possession of the knife., Defeat the Tonberry and claim the cutlery!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Tonberries Everywhere
description: The kitchen knife possessed by the previous Tonberry was not the chef's legendary knife., But we have new information about another Tonberry with the chef's precious cutlery., Hurry there and defeat the Tonberry!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Stack HP% via Potions after unlocking Item Fusion in Ch. 4 (M7-2-1).

title: Master Tonberry
description: Despite the number of Tonberries in the last mission, not one held the chef's legendary knife., But the latest news is the most reliable yet., The Master Tonberry in the caves is in possession of it! Go slay the Master Tonberry!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Endgame Hard Mode: max VIT/SPR 255, 99,999 HP & Genji equipment.

title: Vacation Time
description: You are hereby granted a vacation to Shinra's own resort, Costa del Sol., We hope the time off will relieve some of your stress.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

title: Vacation for Real
description: Your previous break was rudely interrupted by an attacking Genesis battalion, so here is your permit for a real vacation in Costa del Sol., We hope you enjoy your time off.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

title: Please Make it a Vacation
description: We never would have thought Sahagins lived in the waters of Costa del Sol., Please enjoy some real time off at our exclusive resort. The third time is the charm!

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Use Wall/Barrier and Darkness or High Jump; raise Buster Sword to 23%+.

subGroup: M10-4: More Fun in the Sun!
title: You Need a Vacation
description: Even the meteorological bureau was surprised to hear that the rise in water temperature at Costa del Sol was being caused by Bombs., We can't blame you for convulsions of nature, so here is your permit for another break.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Equip 4 Accessory slots (M7-2-2 & M7-2-5) and Element/Status Ward.

subGroup: M10-4: More Fun in the Sun!
title: We Hope it's a Vacation
description: We don't know what else to call it but bad luck; both you and Dr. Hojo were taking your breaks at Costa del Sol at the same time., You deserve a real vacation, so here is your permit., Please try to make it count this time.

hardModeBenchmarks.notes: Keep Barrier up and practice Perfect Guards in Battle Stance.

subGroup: M10-4: More Fun in the Sun!
title: Is it a Vacation Yet?
description: If word has come out that Costa del Sol had an abnormal growth in its sea worm population, it would have spelled the end of our prized resort., As a token of our appreciation for defending its image, here is a permit for one last vacation at Costa del Sol., But, we're sorry to say this is your last one...
